title: Calendar
hours_unset: No business hours are set, so routing treats every hour as staffed.
hours_footer: Outside these hours the agent answers instead of passing a caller to a person.
sync_ok: Free/busy is read live from this calendar. The agent uses it to propose times — it never books.
sync_offline: The calendar did not answer just now. The agent offers to take a message instead of promising a time.
readonly_note: This view shows busy periods only — no names and no details leave the calendar server. Appointments are managed in your calendar, not here.
empty_body: Connect a CalDAV calendar — Nextcloud, iCloud, or any standards server — under Settings → Integrations, and the agent can answer availability questions during a conversation.
offline_body: The CalDAV server is not answering. What you see is the last answer it gave; the agent offers to take a message instead of promising a time.
error_title: The calendar server rejected the credentials
error_body: Tel-Agent reached the CalDAV server but was refused at sign-in — the app password was most likely revoked or expired. Until it is replaced, the agent offers to take a message instead of proposing times.
